definition_title: Weighted support bounds and polynomial slicing
natural_language_statement: For a weight function ρ, SupportBound ρ N p means every exponent in the support of p has ρ-weight at most N. These bounds are monotone in N, hold for zero and constants, and are preserved by sums, products with added bounds, and powers with the bound multiplied by the exponent. The bundle also bounds algebraic evaluations of monomials and polynomials and defines slice maps that retain variables in a finite set and substitute chosen constants for the others.
explanation: The results provide a support-based weighted-degree calculus for multivariate polynomials. They transfer exponent-weight bounds through elementary polynomial operations and through algebraic evaluation, including the finite-coordinate slice maps used to restrict a polynomial to selected variables.
